name: td_pops_query
description: Search the local POPs knowledge base or fetch a specific operator doc by page slug (e.g. Particle_POP).

name: td_ops_query
description: Search the local operator knowledge base (TOP/CHOP/SOP/DAT) or fetch a specific operator doc by family+page slug (e.g. TOP + Noise_TOP).

name: td_templates_query
description: Search reusable patterns and project-specific markdown templates inside Toe_Expand documentation.

name: td_alias_resolve
description: Resolve prompt vocabulary like feedback loop, life, size, cd or direction into canonical TouchDesigner parameters, attributes and family hints.

name: td_get_param_help
description: Look up the available parameters for a TouchDesigner operator type (e.g. 'noiseTOP') from the local knowledge base.

name: td_search_official_docs
description: Search TouchDesigner's built-in offline help for operator documentation, parameter info, and usage summaries.

name: td_export_network
description: Generate Python code, a simplified git-diff, or a JSON snapshot that captures the structure of a TouchDesigner network. Introspects the children of a container operator and produces output in the requested format.

name: td_list_tutorials
description: List available TouchDesigner tutorials. Filter by category (audio, glow, feedback, particles, shader) and/or difficulty (beginner, intermediate, advanced).

name: td_get_tutorial
description: Get the full markdown content of a tutorial by its name (filename without .md extension). Use td_list_tutorials to find available tutorials.

name: td_list_workflows
description: List available reusable TouchDesigner workflow patterns. Filter by category (color, blur, keying, feedback, audio, transform, analyze) and/or difficulty (beginner, intermediate, advanced).

name: td_get_workflow
description: Get the full markdown content of a workflow by its name (filename without .md extension). Use td_list_workflows to find available workflows.

name: td_get_td_classes
description: List all TouchDesigner operator classes from the local knowledge base, organized by family (TOP, CHOP, SOP, DAT, POP, COMP). Each class includes its page title, slug, URL, and optional tdOpTypeGuess.

name: td_get_module_help
description: Look up detailed documentation for a specific TouchDesigner operator by its page slug or tdOpTypeGuess. Searches both the main operator index (TOP/CHOP/SOP/DAT) and POPs index (POP). Returns parameter details, inputs, attributes, and usage examples.

name: td_knowledge_query
description: Search across the comprehensive POP knowledge base (Docs/110-118) for relevant documentation on TouchDesigner POPs. Covers fundamentals, GLSL, forces, physics, rendering, workflows, new features, operator parameters, troubleshooting, and more. Returns the most relevant document sections matching the query.

name: td_create_operator
description: Create a new operator in TouchDesigner. Specify the opType (e.g. noiseTOP, constantTOP, nullCHOP) and optional name, parent path, and position.

name: td_delete_operator
description: Delete a TouchDesigner operator by its full path.

name: td_connect_nodes
description: Connect two TouchDesigner operators by wiring an output to an input.

name: td_disconnect
description: Disconnect an input of a TouchDesigner operator from its source.

name: td_copy_node
description: Duplicate a TouchDesigner operator. If destination is omitted, copies to the same parent.

name: td_pars_get
description: Read current parameters from a TouchDesigner operator, including values, expressions, styles and menus.

name: td_pars_set
description: Set TouchDesigner parameters transactionally. Supports plain values and expressions, with rollback on failure.

name: td_set_operator_pars
description: Set parameters on a TouchDesigner operator with a cleaner interface. Supports transactional rollback on failure.

name: td_pulse_param
description: Pulse a parameter on a TouchDesigner operator (e.g. Cook, Reset, Save).

name: td_custom_parameters
description: Create or update custom parameter pages on a TouchDesigner operator declaratively.

name: td_pane
description: Get the current network editor pane state including the network path, position (x, y), and zoom level.

name: td_selection
description: Get the currently selected operators in the network editor. Returns operator info including path, name, type, and family.

name: td_operators
description: List all child operators at the specified path. Returns operator info including name, type, and opType.

name: td_find
description: Find operators by query, name, family or operator type within a network path.

name: td_connections
description: Inspect real input/output connections for an operator or a whole network subtree.

name: td_get_errors
description: Get errors and warnings from a TouchDesigner operator or entire network. Force-cooks each operator and reports issues.

name: td_healthcheck
description: Force-cook and validate a TouchDesigner operator/network, reporting errors, warnings and per-operator issues.

name: td_get_node_detail
description: Get detailed information about a TouchDesigner operator: parameters, inputs, flags, and optionally recursive children.

name: td_get_hints
description: Get hints and wiring guidance for a specific TouchDesigner operator type.

name: td_get_info
description: Get TouchDesigner environment info: build version, date, commercial status, platform.

name: td_get_focus
description: Get the current user focus in TouchDesigner: which network is open, selected operators, current operator.

name: td_get_perf
description: Get performance data from TouchDesigner: FPS, cook budget, GPU memory, and slowest operators sorted by cook time.

name: td_pop_inspect
description: Read particle data from a POP operator: point/prim/vert counts, attributes with types, and sampled attribute values.

name: td_get_build_compatibility
description: Check if a specific operator type exists in current TD build.

name: td_get_release_delta
description: Get information about what changed between TouchDesigner builds.

name: td_execute
description: Execute Python code in TouchDesigner. The code runs in TD's Python environment with access to all TD modules (op, ui, etc.). Use 'me' to reference the context operator specified by from_op.

name: td_network_plan
description: Create a dry-run network plan from a prompt using operator databases and semantic aliases, or apply the generated skeleton inside TouchDesigner.

name: td_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of an operator's output. Returns a base64-encoded PNG image.

name: td_get_screenshots
description: Get screenshots of multiple operators in one batch. Returns base64-encoded PNG images for each operator.

name: td_navigate_to
description: Navigate the TouchDesigner Network Editor viewport to show a specific operator. Opens the parent network and centers the view.

name: td_read_textport
description: Read the last N lines from the TouchDesigner textport (console output). Use to see errors, warnings and print output.

name: td_clear_textport
description: Clear the textport log buffer. Use before starting a debug session to keep output focused.

name: td_search
description: Search for text across all code (DAT scripts), parameter expressions, and string parameter values in the TD project.

name: td_reinit_extension
description: Reinitialize an extension on a COMP. Call after finishing code edits to apply changes.

name: td_read_dat
description: Read the text content of a DAT operator in TouchDesigner. Returns content with line numbers.

name: td_write_dat
description: Write or patch text content of a DAT operator. Can do full replacement or StrReplace-style patching.

name: td_read_chop
description: Read CHOP channel sample data. Returns channel values as arrays.

name: td_project_lifecycle
description: Control TouchDesigner project lifecycle: save, load, undo, redo, start/end undo block, or clear undo history.

name: td_snapshot_scene
description: Save a snapshot of an operator's state (all par values, modes, expressions) to a JSON structure. Useful before destructive changes.

name: td_memory_save
description: Save a persistent memory entry with key, content, and optional tags. Memories survive across sessions.

name: td_memory_recall
description: Search saved memories by query text. Returns scored results from persistent memory store.

name: tool_batch
description: Execute multiple tool calls in a single batch. Runs tools sequentially and returns all results together. Max 8 tools per batch.

name: td_history_list
description: List the last N recorded changes (history entries) stored in memory. Each entry shows the operator path, action, and timestamp. Does NOT call into TouchDesigner.

name: td_history_undo
description: Revert the most recent recorded change by restoring the operator's parameters from its pre-change snapshot. Only affects in-memory history; uses snapshot_scene + setParameters.

name: td_history_clear
description: Clear all in-memory history entries. This does NOT affect TouchDesigner — only discards the local undo log.

name: td_watch
description: Start or stop real-time performance monitoring in TouchDesigner. When started, polls getPerf() every `interval` seconds, accumulates samples in a circular buffer, and alerts when any operator exceeds `threshold` ms cook time. Call without arguments to get the current snapshot of the running watch.
